semantics.summary: dynamicArraySizeProfile recognizes four standardized VSA profiles and also permits company-specific prefixed profiles.
semantics.rationale: Chapter 5 explicitly permits custom profiles with a company-specific prefix, so the four standardized values do not form a closed enumeration.

targets.evidence: standard VSA profiles and custom company-specific profiles

verification.observability_reason: Standard profile literals are explicit; acceptance of a custom prefix requires a project/company prefix registry not supplied by generic ARXML.

curation.notes: Never reject a nonstandard value solely because it is outside the four VSA literals. Validate standard-profile structure separately; validate custom prefix only when project policy is supplied.
